title.zh: 注意力机制 · 每个词决定看谁
title.en: Attention · Every Word Decides Where to Look

desc.zh: 从「查询与键的点积」到 softmax 权重、加权求和，再到整句的注意力矩阵：每个词怎样决定「看谁多一点」。
desc.en: From the dot product of query and key, through softmax weights and a weighted sum, to a whole-sentence attention matrix: how each word decides whom to look at.
